title: Mass concrete.
officialText: For areas of high-strength mass concrete, including but not limited to, 8,000 psi (55 158 kPa) or greater and the least dimension being equal to or greater than 36 inches (914 mm), as indicated on the construction documents, a thermal control plan complying with ACI 301, Section 8.1 and acceptable to the registered design professional of record shall be submitted by the contractor.
